headline: Stellantis Chip Shortage Disrupts Fiat Production in Italy
summary: A semiconductor component shortage has disrupted Stellantis' Fiat manufacturing output in Italy, with disruptions potentially lasting through December.
why: Automotive supply chain bottlenecks directly constrain manufacturing output and vehicle delivery timelines for major carmakers.

impacts.name: Stellantis NV
impacts.why: Production halts reduce near-term vehicle deliveries and negatively impact manufacturing revenues.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Extended factory downtime caused by component shortages limits production capacity and affects revenue expectations.
